title: API: /status reports the queue and a live worker
summary: Reads GET /api/v1/status from the running master and checks it reports a queue depth, at least one registered worker, and the fields a console needs for each worker.

steps.title: GET /api/v1/status
steps.explain: The real status endpoint of the running master.

steps.title: Status has queue_depth, workers and worker_count
steps.explain: These three fields are the contract of the status endpoint.

steps.title: At least one worker is registered
steps.explain: Jobs submitted through the API need a worker to run them.

steps.title: worker_count equals the workers listed
steps.explain: The count and the list must agree.

steps.title: Each worker has id, status and heartbeat time
steps.explain: A worker entry without these cannot be shown or monitored.

steps.title: queue_depth is a number of zero or more
steps.explain: A negative or missing depth would mean the queue cannot be read.
